# Protocol Facility Services

> Owner-led commercial cleaning company based in Tampa, Florida, serving Tampa Bay:
> medical offices and med spas, restaurants, offices, retail, fitness studios, coworking
> spaces, and property managers. Commercial work only. Legal entity: Protocol Facility
> Services LLC.

- Med spa cleaning (treatment rooms, reception, retail displays): https://www.protocolcommercialcleaning.com/med-spa-cleaning

- Restaurant cleaning after close (dining room, bar, restrooms, entry): https://www.protocolcommercialcleaning.com/restaurant-cleaning
- Commercial and office cleaning, recurring and after-hours: https://www.protocolcommercialcleaning.com/commercial

## How it works
- Free walkthrough for commercial accounts; response within 24 hours
- Flat per-visit pricing based on square footage, frequency, and scope
- Written checklist for every space; direct line to the owner on every account
- Recurring commercial service is month-to-month (30 days' written notice to cancel)
- Re-clean guarantee: missed checklist items reported within 24 hours are fixed at no charge
